reviews.review:
TLDR: Wanna play a TD who did it right?  Buy it any play.

In a world of crappy carbon copy TD games, one game rises above.

Here is what it does well:
-good variety of enemies/tower units
-rougelike element done well (can be true rougelike or with meta upgrades)
-familiar but not the same mechanics
-maze building which is awesome and more TD should do
-fun way to upgrade units
-nice variety of playstyles and units to accomodate each kind of playstyle
-map variety

Let me list some of the things it DOESN'T have:
-no redundant enemies
-no redundant unit towers
-'puzzle' where they mean only 1 way to win
-no artificial difficulty via NUMBER GO UP enemies

Honestly the only bad drawback is that it's a deckbuilder, but it has enough great stuff in there that mitigates this overused gimmick.
